verdict.rationale: Remote documents a dedicated Sandbox: developers get a seeded sandbox company and an `ra_test_` token, and can fire test webhook deliveries in Sandbox before registering a production callback. Together these show a test environment separate from production. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on how sandbox data is isolated from production, documentation of sandbox parity and reset behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You'll get a seeded sandbox company and a working `ra_test_` token by email — no dashboard step needed for this path.
Fire test deliveries against your endpoint in Sandbox before you register a production callback.
